job: Pick several values from a long list, with search and counts.
purpose: The body of a filter popover: a search row, checkable rows with counts, a summary and Clear. The trigger label summarises the choice. Each change fires fd:change with the selected values. Used inside a popover marked data-fd-filter-list.
useWhen: People filter by several values out of a long list: endpoints, keys, statuses.
Each option has a count worth showing.

avoidWhen.when: One choice from a short list.
A short set of options that all fit on the page.
A single filter chip that opens a menu.
Free-form values typed by the user.

states.name: highlighted
states.how: data-highlighted on a row that has focus or the pointer

states.name: no match
states.how: the fd-checklist-empty row is shown when search finds nothing

variants.useWhen: The row the keyboard or pointer is on.

parts.role: A muted count at the end of the row.

keyboard.does: From the search, moves into the list; then to the next row.
Moves to the previous row, or back to the search.
Jumps to the first or last row.
